why: owner 27 Nov: 1.1.8 draft again, with the hunter pet spell, the npc filter and two names

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.1.8-beta for WoW Forever 1.60.1

New
- Report page: a blinking button 'How can I help WoWFarsi?' opens a 4-step tour. A small card moves next to each part it explains, the page scrolls there and a blinking red frame marks it (the counter, the report line box, the select button, the site address). The same button is on the About page.
- About page: who makes WoWFA (one person, free) and a note asking players to support the project on wowfarsi.ir.
- A hunter's 'Call <pet name>' spell is shown in Persian with the pet's own name and is no longer a miss.
- 19 more NPC names (Twilight Mauler, Roving Tallstrider, the Plains Buzzards, the Paletusks, Eastsea Bombardier and Buccaneer, Jumbo Crawfish, Wildplains Patriarch, Penny Pinderton, Cavalry Guard and others).
- Ten more NPC talk and spell-rank texts (Town Crier of Darkshire, Donna and William's dolly lines, Gil, Adam, the Shadowhide lines, the gryphon master, the Skinning trainer talk, the Artisan Skinning rank text).
- The red alert 'There is nothing to attack.' is Persian.

Fixed
- The error list now starts empty after an update. Old blocks from 1.1.6 no longer show up in a new report.
- A unit the game does not clearly mark as an NPC is never looked up, so a player's name can never reach the NPC miss list.
- A blocked action now also names the last WoWFA hook that ran just before it ('last WoWFA hook: ...'). If the action bar block still happens, the next report points at the exact cause.

Known
- The action bar 'blocked in combat' message from a mouseover is still being traced. Send the line with 'last WoWFA hook' in it.

Everything from 1.1.7 is included.
